attributes.norm_statement: Reinforced concrete beams with three faces exposed to fire must comply with the minimum dimensions and axis distances specified in the table for the corresponding fire resistance rating.
attributes.satisfied_if: (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 30 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 80 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 20) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 120 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 15) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 200 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 10)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 80); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 60 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 100 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 30) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 150 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 25) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 200 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 20)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 100); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 90 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 150 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 40) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 200 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 35) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 250 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 30) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 400 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 25)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 100); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 120 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 200 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 50) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 250 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 45) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 300 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 40) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 500 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 35)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 120); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 180 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 300 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 75) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 350 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 65) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 400 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 60) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 600 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 50)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 140); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 240 AND ((BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 400 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 75) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 500 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 70) OR (BEAM.DIMENSION.B_MIN >= 700 AND BEAM.DISTANCE.A_M >= 60)) AND BEAM.WEB.WIDTH_MIN >= 160)
attributes.notes: The table provides multiple options for minimum dimensions and axis distances for each fire resistance rating. The 'Opción 4' is not always available.

attributes.norm_statement: Reinforced concrete elements must comply with the minimum thickness and equivalent axis distance based on fire resistance rating and flexural direction.
attributes.satisfied_if: (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 30 AND ELEMENT.THICKNESS.H_MIN >= 60 AND ((ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'ONE_DIRECTION' AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 10) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 1.5 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 10) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO > 1.5 AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 2 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 10))); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 60 AND ELEMENT.THICKNESS.H_MIN >= 80 AND ((ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'ONE_DIRECTION' AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 20) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 1.5 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 10) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO > 1.5 AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 2 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 20))); OR (FIRE_RESISTANCE.RATING == 90 AND ELEMENT.THICKNESS.H_MIN >= 100 AND ((ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'ONE_DIRECTION' AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 25) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 1.5 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 15) OR (ELEMENT.FLEXION.DIRECTION == 'TWO_DIRECTIONS' AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO > 1.5 AND ELEMENT.IY_IX_RATIO <= 2 AND ELEMENT.DISTANCE.A_M >= 25)))
attributes.notes: This table specifies requirements for elements under flexion in one or two directions, with different conditions based on the Iy/Ix ratio for two-direction flexion.
